name: application-mobile-form-stepper
title: Mobile Form Stepper
description: One-field-per-screen guided form flow components with progress dots and back/continue navigation, for mobile onboarding.
useWhen: One-field-per-screen guided form flow components with progress dots and back/continue navigation, for mobile onboarding.
avoidWhen: Avoid mobile form stepper when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Mobile Form Stepper uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
